edges.why: The only builder on this screen is the global LinkBuilder in ModalProvider (ui/modals/modal-provider.tsx:206). It opens only on mount when ?newLink is present (modal-provider.tsx:144-151), and only middleware and onboarding set that, both pointing to /[slug]/links (lib/middleware/new-link.ts:17, onboarding success page-client.tsx:198). Nothing under program/resources opens a link builder, so link-builder-header.tsx:91 never renders here.

src/app/assistant/page.tsx renders <Assistant/>, which renders <TimeSavingsSection/> unconditionally (src/components/assistant.tsx:412). That section has an unguarded <Link href="/file-storage"> (time-savings-section.tsx:75), and that link is served by src/app/file-storage/page.tsx.

The templates page sits under app/(commonLayout)/layout.tsx, which wraps it in ConsoleRuntimeProviders (providers.tsx:12) and so CommonLayoutHydrationBoundary; when the profile query fails with not_init_validated (a self-hosted instance whose init password has not been validated), hydration-boundary.tsx:32 redirects to /init, served by app/init/page.tsx. The templates page itself renders the marketplace and only redirects when ?tid is present (page.tsx:59-61).

The (dashboard) layout renders AppSidebar on every dashboard screen (src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:37), which passes the Assistant item with url NAV.chat.href='/chat' (src/components/nav/app-sidebar.tsx:43, src/config/nav.ts:58) to NavOverview, rendered unconditionally at src/components/nav/nav-overview.tsx:49-50; /chat is served by src/app/(dashboard)/chat/page.tsx, a real page.

The root layout renders <Header/> with no props on every page (src/app/layout.tsx:142). The mobile menu overlay, shown when isMenuOpen is true (header.tsx:895), has <Link href="/story"> at header.tsx:956. That link is served by src/app/story/page.tsx.

ImportCsvModal opens only when ?import=csv is in the URL (ui/modals/import-csv-modal/index.tsx:269, use-import-modal-param.ts). The only code that sets it is the links page menu (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/[slug]/links/page-client.tsx:371), so the push at index.tsx:215 never runs on the integration detail screen.

CommandK is mounted app-wide in app/(app)/layout.tsx:124 and the palette is enabled off the mail screen (CommandK.tsx enabled: !mailCommandContext). On /shared/[conversationId] useAccount falls back to the user's account (EmailAccountProvider.tsx:105), so the Analytics item href prefixPath(id,'/stats') (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:86) lands on /[emailAccountId]/stats.
/onboarding-brief is app/(redirects)/onboarding-brief/page.tsx:4, which only calls redirectToEmailAccountPath; the user never stays on that screen.

UpgradeBanner is mounted for every dashboard screen (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:21). When the workspace has paymentFailedAt it shows a Retry button that opens RetryPaymentModal (ui/layout/upgrade-banner.tsx:90,190). If that modal finds no open invoice or hits a load error, it renders the billing link (ui/modals/retry-payment-modal.tsx:135-143), and that link resolves to (ee)/settings/billing/page.tsx.

/refer (app/(app)/refer/page.tsx) sits under the (app) layout that mounts CommandK (layout.tsx:124); useAccount resolves a fallback account id off account routes (EmailAccountProvider.tsx:105), so the Usage command (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:165) pushes /<id>/usage, served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/usage/page.tsx.

ReferButton is passed as toolContent in the dashboard layout (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:28). The sidebar renders it unconditionally (ui/layout/sidebar/sidebar-nav.tsx:141), and its href /account/settings/referrals (refer-button.tsx:24) is a real page (account/settings/referrals/page.tsx).

The (sidebar) layout renders <Sidebar/> (src/app/[locale]/(app)/(sidebar)/layout.tsx:47). Sidebar renders <MainMenu> (sidebar.tsx:51), whose Item Link uses href={item.path} (main-menu.tsx:193). The items list includes /inbox (main-menu.tsx:51), which resolves to the [locale]/(app)/(sidebar)/inbox page.

The root layout renders <Header/> with hideMenuItems=false (layout.tsx:142). The desktop Resources dropdown maps items that include {href:"/mcp"} (header.tsx:653) into <Link href={item.href}> at header.tsx:665. That link is served by src/app/mcp/page.tsx.

EmailViewer is mounted app-wide (app/(app)/layout.tsx:117) and opens from the side-panel-thread-id query param (hooks/useDisplayedEmail.ts:5). It can open on /shared/activity, for example from the global compose modal's 'view sent email' action (compose/useComposeSend.ts:129-133). EmailThread then renders ThreadDeliveryStatus (EmailThread.tsx:491), and a failed or uncertain send shows the 'Check Sent' link to /<id>/mail (ThreadDeliveryStatus.tsx:197-200), which is served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/mail/page.tsx.

debug/mail-queue is a normal client page under the (app) layout, which mounts CommandK (layout.tsx:124); the 'Manage Accounts' command pushes '/accounts' (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:185), served by app/(app)/accounts/page.tsx.

members/page.tsx is under app/[locale]/(space)/(dashboard)/layout.tsx, whose sidebar footer always renders the Settings button linking to /settings/profile (layout.tsx:77-79); the proxy rewrites it to /[locale]/settings/profile, a real page that only redirects when logged out (profile/page.tsx:41).

The (sidebar) layout renders <Header/> (layout.tsx:51), which renders <UserMenu/> without onlySignOut (header.tsx:31). That makes the !onlySignOut block render, including <Link href="/apps"> (user-menu.tsx:88), which resolves to the [locale]/(app)/(sidebar)/apps page.

The monitor incidents page renders a Note with <Link href="/status-pages"> once data loads (src/app/(dashboard)/monitors/[id]/incidents/page.tsx:38-47); /status-pages is served by src/app/(dashboard)/status-pages/(list)/page.tsx, which renders a client list.

The root layout renders Header on /transactions (layout.tsx:142). The mobile menu's Resources section, which opens via a state toggle (header.tsx:1017), has <Link href="/mcp"> at header.tsx:1067. That link is served by src/app/mcp/page.tsx.

On /account/settings/security there is no slug param or query, so useWorkspace loads no workspace (lib/swr/use-workspace.ts:13-31). paymentFailedAt and plan are therefore undefined, which hides the UpgradeBanner (lib/hooks/use-dashboard-banner-visible.ts:21-28) and SidebarUsage (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:676,701), the two places that open RetryPaymentModal. The link is also gated on slug (retry-payment-modal.tsx:138).

setCategoryFilter (use-program-network-filters.tsx:155) is only reachable from MarketplaceSidebarFilters, which sits in the sidebar's 'marketplace' area (ui/layout/sidebar/partners-sidebar-nav.tsx:174-179), and from marketplace list pages. On /programs/[programSlug]/earnings the current area is 'program' (partners-sidebar-nav.tsx:387-399). Non-current areas stay mounted but are invisible and inert (ui/layout/sidebar/sidebar-nav.tsx:494-507), so no filter can be clicked.

Header renders from the root layout on every page, including /mcp/zapier (src/app/mcp/zapier/page.tsx just renders <MCPZapier/>). Its mobile menu has <Link href="/story"> at header.tsx:956, which lands on src/app/story/page.tsx.

ProgramAnalyticsShell always renders ProgramAnalyticsNav (program-analytics-shell.tsx:269). Its PageNavTabs links to `${basePath}/${id}` with basePath /${slug}/program/analytics and ids performance/commissions/applications (program-analytics-nav.tsx:15-27, ui/layout/page-nav-tabs.tsx:98). No static sibling pages exist, so these land on analytics/[tab]/page.tsx.

The dashboard layout calls loadUser() (dashboard/layout.tsx:38), and loadUser redirects a signed-out or guest visitor to /login (features/user/loaders.ts:71-77), which is served by app/[locale]/(auth)/login. loadActiveSpace in the (space) layout checks the same condition and also goes to /login, so the landing screen is the same either way.

The root layout renders <Footer/> unconditionally (layout.tsx:146). The Resources column maps items that include {href:"/computer"} (footer.tsx:116) into <Link href={item.href}> at footer.tsx:140. That link is served by src/app/computer/page.tsx.

On /[emailAccountId]/integrations useAccount returns the route id, so the Assistant item href is prefixPath(id,'/automation') = /<id>/automation (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:74, utils/path.ts:2), served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/automation/page.tsx, not the bare /automation (which is only a redirect page, app/(redirects)/automation/page.tsx:8).

Pricing.tsx:367 only pushes /login when !isLoggedIn, where isLoggedIn = !!usePremium().data?.id (Pricing.tsx:53). Every (app) screen, calendars included, is behind app/(app)/layout.tsx:72, which redirects to /login unless there's a session, so a signed-in user is always there and this branch never runs.
app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/settings/page.tsx:8 does nothing except redirect to /settings; the source screen is redirect-only, so the user never stays there.

The survey page sits under (onboarding)/organizations/[organizationId]/layout.tsx, which redirects to /auth/login when getSession() has no user (layout.tsx:20-24). The proxy usually redirects a logged-out visitor to /auth/login first (proxy.ts:15-17, endpoint-validator.ts:44 protects /organizations), so this call is a fallback, but it lands on the same login screen. Adjudicated between judges: wrong-source vs correct.

The back link renders only when settingsHeader returns `back`, which happens only for section 'environments' with an `environment` param (settings/layout.tsx:35,61-63; settings/sections.ts:33-34). The [page] screen has no [environment] segment, so `back` is undefined and the link never renders. Even when it does render (on environments/[environment]), /settings/environments goes to the static settings/environments/page.tsx, not [page].

The /marketplace link at marketplace-sidebar-filters.tsx:33 lives in the sidebar's 'marketplace' area (partners-sidebar-nav.tsx:174-179). On /profile/postbacks the current area is 'profile' (partners-sidebar-nav.tsx:389-391), so that area is invisible and inert (sidebar-nav.tsx:494-507) and the link can't be clicked.

NavStatusPages is rendered in AppSidebar (src/components/nav/app-sidebar.tsx:79) on every dashboard screen and links each status page to /status-pages/${id}/status-reports (src/components/nav/nav-status-pages.tsx:115-132) when the workspace has pages; that is served by status-pages/[id]/status-reports/(list)/page.tsx.

Footer renders on every page from the root layout (layout.tsx:146). Its Resources column includes {href:"/terms"} (footer.tsx:131), which renders as a Link at footer.tsx:140 and lands on src/app/terms/page.tsx.

On /apps/new, FlowLoader's ResumedFlow renders AppRedirect when resumeWizard returns kind 'app', i.e. the ?appId in the URL names an app that has already deployed (apps/new/flow.tsx:97-99, wizard-model.ts:205-206). AppRedirect then router.replace()s to routes.projects.apps.overview (flow.tsx:107-112), served by apps/[appId]/(overview)/overview/page.tsx. This happens in normal use when the wizard URL is revisited after a deploy.

NavMonitors is rendered on every dashboard screen (src/components/nav/app-sidebar.tsx:80); its clone action's onSuccess pushes /monitors/${id} (src/components/nav/nav-monitors.tsx:76,152), and src/app/(dashboard)/monitors/[id]/page.tsx:9 redirects that to /monitors/${id}/overview, so the user lands on the overview screen.

The apps/new footer comes only from AppCrumb (components/navigation/top-nav/app-crumb.tsx:53-56), and useBreadcrumbs adds an app crumb only when the route has both projectId and appId params (hooks/use-breadcrumbs.ts:55-57). /[workspaceSlug]/identities has neither, so only the workspace crumb renders, and its footer goes to routes.workspaces.create() (workspace-crumb.tsx:70).

The push at ui/folders/folder-dropdown.tsx:97 runs only when disableAutoRedirect is unset. Of the three FolderDropdown users, only the links page leaves it unset (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/[slug]/links/page-client.tsx:12). link-builder-folder-selector.tsx:23 and move-link-form.tsx:92 both pass disableAutoRedirect, and program/leads renders none of them (leads/page.tsx imports only the lead table and form button).

Footer renders from the root layout (layout.tsx:146). Its Features column includes {href:"/invoicing"} (footer.tsx:33), which renders as <Link href={item.href}> at footer.tsx:44 and lands on src/app/invoicing/page.tsx.

The sidebar's NavStatusPages create button calls router.push('/status-pages/create') when the limit isn't reached (src/components/nav/nav-status-pages.tsx:89-94), and the sidebar renders on /incidents/[id] through the (dashboard) layout (src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:37); the target is a real page (status-pages/create/page.tsx).

The embedded-data settings page renders LibraryCard (modules/embedded-data/settings/page.tsx:31), which mounts DeleteFieldDialog when a row's delete action is chosen (library-card.tsx:106-115). If the delete is refused because surveys still use the field, the dialog lists each one with a link to /workspaces/{id}/surveys/{surveyId}/edit (delete-field-dialog.tsx:99-100), served by the (survey-editor) edit page.

The Header logo <Link href="/"> at header.tsx:265 is unconditional, and Header renders from the root layout on /mcp/gemini. The link lands on src/app/page.tsx. The /en/* and /insights redirects in next.config do not affect "/".

/[emailAccountId]/setup isn't a mail or onboarding path, so SideNavWithTopNav.tsx:111-114 renders SideNav, whose footer renders NavUser (SideNav.tsx:395). The Premium item links to '/premium' (NavUser.tsx:165) unless NEXT_PUBLIC_BYPASS_PREMIUM_CHECKS is set (NavUser.tsx:161), and it's served by app/(app)/premium/page.tsx.

Header renders on /assistant from the root layout. Its desktop Resources dropdown, shown when isAppsOpen is true on hover, has the Integrations preview <Link href="/integrations"> at header.tsx:758. That link is served by src/app/integrations/page.tsx.

On /[emailAccountId]/assistant/rule/[ruleId] the Mail item href is prefixPath(routeId,'/mail') = /<id>/mail (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:68), served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/mail/page.tsx, not bare /mail (which only redirects, app/(redirects)/mail/page.tsx).

The (app) layout renders <SiteHeader/> (app/(app)/layout.tsx:10). SiteHeader passes navItems={siteConfig.navItems} to CommandMenu (site-header.tsx:33-36). Those items include /typeset (lib/config.ts:37), and the menu pushes them via router.push(item.href) (command-menu.tsx:202). /typeset is served by app/(app)/(typeset)/typeset/page.tsx.

Header renders on /transactions. The desktop Features dropdown's first column maps {href:"/time-tracking"} (header.tsx:350) into <Link href={item.href}> at header.tsx:364. That link lands on src/app/time-tracking/page.tsx.
app/(app)/blocks/layout.tsx:51 renders <Announcement/>, whose <Link href="/docs/changelog"> is at components/announcement.tsx:9. That link is served by the static app/(app)/docs/changelog/page.tsx.

The store layout wraps the page in SidebarProvider and renders <DashboardSidebarSheet> inside DashboardHeader (store/[storeId]/layout.tsx:36,53). On non-desktop widths (the isDesktop check at dashboard-sidebar-sheet.tsx:30), the sheet shows <Link href="/"> at line 54. That link lands on src/app/(lobby)/page.tsx. The products page calls notFound() only when the store is missing (products/page.tsx:48).

MainNavigation.tsx:303 is handleWorkspaceChange, which only the workspace switcher dropdown calls (line 547), and that dropdown renders only when !isSettingsMode (line 511), where isSettingsMode = pathname.includes('/settings') (line 158), so it cannot run on a /settings/workspace/app-connection screen. It also pushes /workspaces/{id}/surveys or /workspaces/{id}/ (line 300), never the enterprise page; the enterprise href is a limit-modal button at line 349. Adjudicated between judges: wrong-target vs wrong-source.

The settings layout renders NavUser in its sidebar footer (app/[locale]/(space)/settings/layout.tsx:82), and its dropdown has a Preferences item linking to /settings/preferences (nav-user.tsx:80). That is the same preferences page, which renders normally (preferences/page.tsx:24).

The rule-history/[ruleId] page is a real server page under the (app) layout, which mounts CommandK (layout.tsx:124). The Assistant item pushes prefixPath(id,'/automation') (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:74), which lands on app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/automation/page.tsx.

The app overview route has a projectId param, so useBreadcrumbs pushes a project crumb (hooks/use-breadcrumbs.ts:46-50). ProjectCrumb's footer is 'New project' with href routes.projects.list({new:true}) = /[ws]/projects?new=true (project-crumb.tsx:40-44, routes/projects.ts:22-23), rendered as a Link at crumb-popover.tsx:149-150. TopNav is mounted in app/(app)/layout.tsx, and /[ws]/projects is a real page.

/organization/[organizationId] isn't an assistant route, so SidebarRight renders the chat (SideNavWithTopNav.tsx:118-119, SidebarRight.tsx:46). Chat rule tool results open RuleDialog (components/assistant-chat/tools.tsx:1761), which renders RuleForm, whose NotifyChannelRow (RuleForm.tsx:556) shows 'Connect' to prefixPath(fallbackId,'/channels') when no channel is connected (RuleForm.tsx:710-723). That lands on app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/channels/page.tsx.

Account settings use SettingsShell (account/settings/layout.tsx:17), which renders TopControlBar with showWorkspaceBreadcrumb={false} (settings-shell.tsx:77). That makes workspaceCrumbId undefined in workspace-and-org-switch.tsx:43, so WorkspaceBreadcrumb, and the router.push at workspace-breadcrumb.tsx:100, never renders (line 55-56). MainNavigation is not rendered there either.

On /[slug]/links/events the sidebar area is 'links' (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:567-579). On a plan that can track conversions, AppBottomContent renders the 'Set up conversion tracking' link because the pathname starts with /${slug}/links (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:644-665). The link lands on (ee)/settings/tracking/page.tsx. It is hidden only when the 'set as default product' button takes priority.

The workflow generator is mounted on every (commonLayout) screen (global-mounts.tsx:27), so it can run on the agent page. But applyToNewApp only creates 'workflow' or 'advanced-chat' apps (apply.ts:8-11, 92), so getRedirectionPath skips the agent branch that returns /agents (app-redirection.ts:16-17) and returns /app/{id}/workflow or another /app/{id}/* path, or /apps.

NavOverview's Monitors item links to NAV.monitors.href='/monitors' (src/components/nav/app-sidebar.tsx:50, src/config/nav.ts:40, nav-overview.tsx:50) on every dashboard screen; /monitors is served by src/app/(dashboard)/monitors/(list)/page.tsx, which renders a client.

The global CommandMenu sits in the (dashboard) layout (src/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:38). Its root createGroup includes 'Declare Incident' (src/components/command-menu/groups/static.ts:30-36,64), which mounts DeclareIncidentButton (command-menu.tsx:262-268). On a successful declare that pushes /incidents/${id} (src/components/incidents/declare-incident-button.tsx:51), served by incidents/[id]/page.tsx.

clean/onboarding has 3 path segments and isn't a mail path, so SideNav renders (SideNavWithTopNav.tsx:91-114) with PremiumCard (SideNav.tsx:379). With the sidebar collapsed, a non-premium new user sees the icon link to buttonHref='/premium' (PremiumCard.tsx:129,159), which is served by app/(app)/premium/page.tsx.

redirect('/new') in useWorkspaceNavigation runs only when there is no workspace and no error (hooks/use-workspace-navigation.tsx:26-37). But app/(app)/layout.tsx returns a LoadingState whenever `!workspace`, and pushes to workspaces.create when the workspace is missing, so nothing under it, including this keyspace settings screen, renders without a workspace.

The projects list renders a ProjectCard per project (projects/_components/list/index.tsx:101). Each card links to routes.projects.detail = /[ws]/projects/[projectId] (project-card.tsx:33,46-47), which serves a real Apps page (projects/[projectId]/page.tsx).

header.tsx:718 is the plain <a> in the item.external branch (header.tsx:716); the only external item in that list is https://api.midday.ai (header.tsx:684). /sdks has external:false, so it renders through the Link at header.tsx:733, not this call site. Adjudicated: nori credits every item of a literal list to both branches.

The only path to RewardDiscountPartnersCard from this screen is review sheet, then PartnerInfoCards (program-application-review-sheet.tsx:135), then the edit-reward modal, then RewardSheet (edit-partner-reward-modal.tsx:366). The Rewards section with the edit buttons renders only when partner.status === 'approved' (ui/partners/partner-info-cards.tsx:479), and this page lists only pending applications (applications/page.tsx: status="pending"). The only exception is a stale ?applicationId= deep link to an application approved since, which isn't normal use.

The key detail route sits under projects/[projectId], so useBreadcrumbs adds a project crumb (hooks/use-breadcrumbs.ts:46-50). Its popover footer links to /[ws]/projects?new=true (project-crumb.tsx:40-44, crumb-popover.tsx:149-150), and TopNav renders on every (app) screen (app/(app)/layout.tsx).

The notifications page sits under app/[locale]/(space)/settings/layout.tsx, which renders NavUser in its sidebar footer (layout.tsx:82). Its dropdown has a Profile item linking to /settings/profile (nav-user.tsx:76), served by the settings/profile page.

SettingsDialog is mounted app-wide (app/(app)/layout.tsx:118) and opens from NavUser's Settings item or the palette (NavUser.tsx:92, useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:58). It renders SettingsContent, whose Beta Features row links to '/early-access' unconditionally (SettingsContent.tsx:186), and that's served by app/(app)/early-access/page.tsx.

The app-wide SettingsDialog (layout.tsx:118) renders SettingsContent with DeleteSection (SettingsContent.tsx:191). For a user with more than one connected account, its delete dialog shows the 'Remove just one account instead' link to /accounts (DeleteSection.tsx:169-171), served by app/(app)/accounts/page.tsx.

TopNav (app/(app)/layout.tsx) renders UserButton, whose menu links to routes.account.overview = /[ws]/account (components/navigation/top-nav/user-button.tsx:66, routes/account.ts:10-11), a real page. stripe/checkout/page.tsx mostly redirects to Stripe, but it also renders in-app states such as 'Admin access required' (stripe/checkout/page.tsx:73-80), where the user stays and can open the menu.

The tracking link at app-sidebar-nav.tsx:658 renders only when pathname.startsWith(`/${slug}/links`) (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:657). On /[slug]/settings/logs the pathname doesn't match, and the area there is workspaceSettings, where AppBottomContent is otherwise null (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:567-570,644-666).

The footer link to /cal does render on landing pages (src/content/footer.tsx:30), but src/app/(landing)/(redirect)/cal/page.tsx:4 only redirects to an external cal.com URL, so the user never stays on /cal.

clean/onboarding is a real page under the (app) layout with CommandK mounted (layout.tsx:124). The Cold Email Blocker item is always in the list (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:126-131) and pushes /<id>/cold-email-blocker, served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/cold-email-blocker/page.tsx.

The usage page does not render RuleForm. The only way to reach it there is the chat sidebar's RuleDialog (components/assistant-chat/tools.tsx:1761), which always passes isDialog and onSuccess (RuleDialog.tsx:97-98,124-125). That makes RuleForm.tsx:301 call onSuccess and skip the router.push at line 307, which is also a create-only path. The pushed URL would anyway be /{id}/automation, not /automation. Adjudicated between judges: wrong-target vs wrong-source.

ImportCsvModal opens only when ?import=csv is set (ui/modals/import-csv-modal/index.tsx:269, use-import-modal-param.ts). Only the links page sets it (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/[slug]/links/page-client.tsx:371), so the push at index.tsx:215 never runs on program/risks/resolved.

Pricing.tsx:367 pushes /login only when the user isn't logged in (isLoggedIn = !!data?.id, Pricing.tsx:53). /[emailAccountId]/assistant sits behind app/(app)/layout.tsx:72, which redirects anonymous users to /login, so this branch can't run there.

On the group-level success page, useParams supplies groupSlug, so the header link is `/${programSlug}/${groupSlug}` (app/(ee)/partners.dub.co/(apply)/[programSlug]/(default)/header.tsx:26-28,46). That URL lands on (group-level)/[groupSlug]/page.tsx, which serves /partners.dub.co/[programSlug]/[groupSlug], not /[programSlug].

ActionSteps.tsx:1074 links to prefixPath(emailAccountId,'/channels'). On /[emailAccountId]/debug/memories that's /<id>/channels, served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/channels/page.tsx, not bare /channels (only a redirect page, app/(redirects)/channels/page.tsx).

channelsPath = prefixPath(emailAccountId,'/channels') (RuleForm.tsx:710). On /no-access useAccount falls back to one of the user's accounts (EmailAccountProvider.tsx:105), so the link goes to /<id>/channels. Bare /channels only redirects anyway (app/(redirects)/channels/page.tsx), so it's not a landing screen.

SideNavWithTopNav.tsx:86,111 skips SideNav (the only renderer of NavUser, SideNav.tsx:395) on any path containing /mail, so this link never renders on /[emailAccountId]/mail. Even where it does render, /<id>/organization/create hits the static app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/organization/create/page.tsx, not /organization/[organizationId].

The (lobby) layout renders <SiteHeader user={user}/> (layout.tsx:14), and SiteHeader renders <AuthDropdown/> (site-header.tsx:24). For a signed-in user without a store, AuthDropdownGroup links to "/onboarding" (auth-dropdown.tsx:112). That lands on (dashboard)/onboarding/page.tsx, which renders real content and redirects only when signed out.

On /settings useAccount resolves the user's fallback account id (EmailAccountProvider.tsx:105), so the Analytics href is /<id>/stats (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:86, utils/path.ts:2), served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/stats/page.tsx. Bare /stats is only a redirect page anyway (app/(redirects)/stats/page.tsx).

The maintenances list layout renders the shared status-page Sidebar (src/app/(dashboard)/status-pages/[id]/maintenances/(list)/layout.tsx, `import { Sidebar } from "../../sidebar"`; it is hidden below lg but present). For each attached component that Sidebar renders a TableCellLink to /status-pages/${id}/components (src/app/(dashboard)/status-pages/[id]/sidebar.tsx:128-135), served by status-pages/[id]/components/page.tsx.

The configuration page renders Configuration, whose ConfigurationView opens NewFeaturePanel with inWorkflow={false} and isChatMode for non-completion apps (configuration-view/index.tsx:286-290). That panel renders AnnotationReply (new-feature-panel/index.tsx:120-121). With annotation reply enabled and the card hovered, it links to /app/{appId}/annotations (annotation-reply/index.tsx:137-138), taking appId from the pathname (line 28-29), and that annotations page renders the log-annotation view.

Org settings pages use SettingsShell (organizations/[organizationId]/settings/layout.tsx:23), which renders SettingsNavigation in place of MainNavigation and passes showWorkspaceBreadcrumb={false} to TopControlBar (settings-shell.tsx:77). The only mounts of CreateWorkspaceModal reachable from a shell are in MainNavigation.tsx:623 and workspace-breadcrumb.tsx:206, and neither renders here (workspace-and-org-switch.tsx:43,55).

SidebarUsage renders in the sidebar bottom for free-plan or trial workspaces in any area (app-sidebar-nav.tsx:676-702). During a trial it shows the 'N days left' link to /${slug}/settings/billing (ui/layout/sidebar/sidebar-usage.tsx:126-137). That applies on program/risks too, and the link lands on (ee)/settings/billing/page.tsx.

The push at ui/modals/link-builder/index.tsx:146 runs only when the route has a `link` param (index.tsx:139-144), which exists only on /[slug]/links/[...link]. On /account/settings/tokens there is no link param, and the global builder never opens there anyway: ?newLink is only set toward /[slug]/links (modal-provider.tsx:144-151, lib/middleware/new-link.ts:17).

The admin layout renders SettingsLayoutAppDir ((admin-layout)/layout.tsx:24), whose Shell gets a custom SidebarContainer and TopNavContainer={<MobileSettingsContainer/>} (SettingsLayoutAppDirClient.tsx:547-558). Those replace the default SideBar and TopNav (Shell.tsx:48-51, 201), which are the only places UserDropdown renders (SideBar.tsx:88, TopNav.tsx:41).

The (lobby) layout renders SiteHeader, which renders <MainNav/> (site-header.tsx:18). MainNav has an unconditional logo <Link href="/"> (main-nav.tsx:27) that shows at lg widths. That link lands on src/app/(lobby)/page.tsx.

The [slug] layout wraps every workspace screen, group settings included, in WorkspaceAuth (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/[slug]/layout.tsx). WorkspaceAuth redirects to /${slug}/invite when the workspace fetch returns invite_pending or invite_expired (auth.tsx:20-25). That URL lands on app/app.dub.co/(invites)/[slug]/invite/page.tsx, a real invite page.

The (sidebar) layout renders Sidebar, and Sidebar renders MainMenu (sidebar.tsx:51). The items list includes /reports (main-menu.tsx:29), which renders through <Link href={item.path}> at main-menu.tsx:193 and lands on [locale]/(app)/(sidebar)/reports/page.tsx.

The TopNav logo links to routes.workspaces.overview = /[ws] (components/navigation/top-nav/index.tsx:35-36). But app/(app)/[workspaceSlug]/page.tsx does nothing except router.replace() to /[ws]/projects in an effect and render null, so the user never stays on /[ws].

ComputePausedBanner is mounted in app/(app)/layout.tsx above every screen and renders a 'Manage billing' link to /[ws]/settings/billing when workspace.deploySpendSuspended is set (components/navigation/compute-paused-banner.tsx:19,33-34). That is a reachable workspace state, and settings/billing/page.tsx is a real page.

The /[locale] home is app/[locale]/(space)/(dashboard)/page.tsx, which renders DashboardHome, under a dashboard layout that renders NavUser in the sidebar footer (dashboard/layout.tsx:89). Its Preferences item links to /settings/preferences (nav-user.tsx:80), served by the settings/preferences page.

On /[emailAccountId]/debug/rule-history the Assistant item pushes /<routeId>/automation (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:74), served by app/(app)/[emailAccountId]/automation/page.tsx, not bare /automation (which only redirects, app/(redirects)/automation/page.tsx:8).

debug/drafts is a real client page under the (app) layout with CommandK (layout.tsx:124). The always-present Cold Email Blocker item (useCommandPaletteCommands.ts:126-131) pushes /<id>/cold-email-blocker, which is a real page.

For workspaces that can message partners and have messages.write permission, MessagesLayout's CapableLayout renders PartnerSelector on every messages screen, including /messages/[partnerId] (program/messages/layout.tsx:25-27,86-92). Picking a partner pushes /${slug}/program/messages/${id}, which lands on messages/[partnerId]/page.tsx.

Chat tool renderers render EntityRef cards (e.g. src/components/chat/tool-renderers/list-status-reports.tsx). PageCard passes href=entityKinds.page.href(data) = /status-pages/${id}/status-reports (src/components/common/entity-ref/cards/page.tsx:32, src/data/entity-refs.client.ts:32) to the NextLink at parts.tsx:39-40, so it opens the status-reports screen (in a new tab).

assistant/rule/create isn't a mail path, so SideNav (and PremiumCard, SideNav.tsx:379) renders there; the /assistant check only hides SidebarRight (SideNavWithTopNav.tsx:111-119). With the sidebar collapsed, a user whose subscription lapsed (not a new user) gets buttonHref='/settings' in the hover card (PremiumCard.tsx:129,148), served by app/(app)/settings/page.tsx.

ImportCsvModal opens only via ?import=csv (ui/modals/import-csv-modal/index.tsx:269), which only the links page sets (links/page-client.tsx:371). /account/settings/security also has no slug or workspace. The push at index.tsx:215 never runs here.

The dashboard layout passes ReferButton as sidebar toolContent for every dashboard screen (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:28). The sidebar renders it unconditionally (sidebar-nav.tsx:141), and it links to /account/settings/referrals (refer-button.tsx:24), a real page.

UpgradeBanner is mounted in the dashboard layout (app/app.dub.co/(dashboard)/layout.tsx:21). When a production workspace has exceeded its events, links or payouts limit, it renders the 'limit' link to /${slug}/settings/billing (ui/layout/upgrade-banner.tsx:84,105-109). That applies on program/groups too, and the link lands on (ee)/settings/billing/page.tsx.
